objects.name: JetBrains security advisory (AV26-739)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-739 Date: July 23, 2026 On July 23, 2026, JetBrains published security advisories to address vulnerabilities in the following products: JetBrains GoLand - versions prior to 2026.2 JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA - version prior to 2026.2 JetBrains PhpStorm - version prior to 2026.2 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web link and apply the necessary updates. JetBrains – Fixed security issues
